notes.title: Demo Update v0.8.109
notes.content: [p]Update v0.8.109 is now live, with a whole bunch of balance changes thanks to all the incredible feedback that has been given here, on Itch and via the in-game options - literally everything in this patch is in response to one or more comments so a huge thanks to everyone who has been in touch, it's really helping me shape the game into something that can be hopefully be enjoyed by anyone, pinball enthusiast or not.  These changes are primarily focused on being more beginner friendly while  keeping it challenging for those playing on higher difficulties. As always, please let me know what you think![/p][p align="start"][b]v0.8.107 Patch Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]All Blockers are now reset when starting a new ball[/p][/*][*][p]Blocker HP reduced to [i]10 [/i]hits (was [i]15[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]On Expert difficulties and above, this is reduced further to only [i]6 [/i]hits[/p][/*][*][p]Menu navigation can now be done using arrow keys or left/right ctrl, with spacebar or enter to confirm[/p][/*][*][p]Added Slow-motion effect on exiting the Shop, giving a bit more time to get your bearings.[/p][/*][*][p]New Blessing: [i]Bubble Blockers: Blockers gain a protective bubble, that respawns 15s after being hit[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Increased Boss tentacle respawn timer on lower levels. [/p][/*][*][p]Each time a Boss tentacle is hit, it's respawn timer will increase.[/p][/*][*][p]Blessings rebalanced to be more impactful (-4 ritual mission count instead of -2 for each type)[/p][/*][*][p]Curses rebalanced to be more impactful[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced damage from Chain Lightning effect[/p][/*][*][p]Bumper HP increased at higher levels (eg Act VI is now [i]1,000,000 [/i]on Easy difficulty, it was [i]250,000[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]When skipping the tutorial, all other popups will now be skipped[/p][/*][*][p]Some minor Glyph rebalancing[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Happy Flipping![/p][p align="start"] Kenny[/p]

notes.title: Massive Update: Blessings, Sparks, Burn and more
notes.content: [p]It has been a crazy week due to being a part the [b]Tiny Teams 2025[/b] Steam festival alongside a huge uptick in players on Itch.io, so first a massive thank you to everyone who has checked the game out so far! And now I'm happy to announce [b]v0.8.87 [/b]of the demo with a whole bunch of fixes and changes but one core new feature I've been working on for a while:[/p][p][b]Blessings! [/b]Blessings are a huge bonus you can select [b]at the end of every Act! [/b]There are 12 to choose from in the demo so far but there will be 32 in the final game, and I'll update the demo to 24 once they've been playtested a bit more. Obviously, this has massively changed the game balance to the point where it might now be a bit [i]too[/i] easy on lower difficulties, but I'll see how it feels for a while before tweaking anything to compensate. Some of these were previously purchasable Glyphs, which I've not removed and replaced with new ones so there are still 40 to unlock in the demo.[/p][p]Currently, the [b]Blessings [/b]you can choose from are:[/p][list][*][p]Reduce the mission count for a specific ritual by 2 (4 Blessings, one for each [i]Multiball[/i], [i]Tempest[/i], [i]Inferno[/i] and [i]Sparks[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]Chain lightning effect between all active balls[/p][/*][*][p]Double Blocker HP[/p][/*][*][p]Increase Mana reward at the end of each Act[/p][/*][*][p]Rerolls in the shop start at 0[/p][/*][*][p]Reduce Glyph prices by 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Increase maximum Glyph count by 2[/p][/*][*][p]Duplicate Glyphs now appear in the shop (good for very specific builds)[/p][/*][/list][p]Additionally, I felt the [i]Sparks [/i]Ritual was a bit underwhelming, and often found it was hard to reach that one last bumper in a stage so I reworked it into dealing high damage to the nearest bumper of each actie ball, which has made it feel much, much more fun to play and when combined with [i]Multiball[/i], absolutely shreds bumpers. Also in this patch is the addition of a [b]Burning[/b] mechanic, triggered by the [i]Inferno [/i]Ritual and the [i]Pyro [/i]ball, where targets take additional damage over time. Overall, much more destruction to be had. [/p][p]Here's the full patch notes for v0.8.87:[/p][list][*][p][b]Blessings [/b]system added[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sparks Ritual [/b]reworked to be much more effective (and fun)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Burning [/b]feature for [i]Inferno [/i]and [i]Pyro[/i] ball, dealing damage over time[/p][/*][*][p]All [b]Blocker Reset Glyphs[/b] no longer take up a Glyph slot (they're just destroyed on use)[/p][/*][*][p]All [b]Blocker Reset Glyphs [/b]now display the blocker HP as a % in the description[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cheater Ball [/b]now grants a spare ball [i]at the end of every Act[/i]. Survivability maxed out.[/p][/*][*][p]Some Glyphs added, others removed. Play to see the full changes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Bumper HP [/b]is now shown at the top of the screen when it's active[/p][/*][*][p]Performance imporvements throughout[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug and text fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]Overall, I feel this is a definitive shift in the game and one I hope makes it altogether a much more enjoyaable experience. While the Demo is still capped at 6 Acts, the full game will have an [b]Endless mode -[/b] last night I managed to get my fist e-number damage alongside a [i]Sparks[/i] and [i]Multiball[/i] combo and it just felt [i]insane[/i]. I hope everyone else will enjoy it as much as I do![/p][p]Happy Flipping![/p][p]Kenny[/p]

tags.feature: [b]Blessings [/b]system added
[b]Sparks Ritual [/b]reworked to be much more effective (and fun)
[b]Burning [/b]feature for [i]Inferno [/i]and [i]Pyro[/i] ball, dealing damage over time
All [b]Blocker Reset Glyphs[/b] no longer take up a Glyph slot (they're just destroyed on use)
[b]Cheater Ball [/b]now grants a spare ball [i]at the end of every Act[/i]. Survivability maxed out.
[b]Boss Bumper HP [/b]is now shown at the top of the screen when it's active

notes.title: Demo Hotfix Patch (v0.8.39)
notes.content: [p]So, it turns out I'd left a development save file in the previous builds, that meant the game skipped the tutorial and had a handful of glyphs already unlocked. This meant no explaination of all the weird mechanics, so kudos to those that played without it and somehow still grasped what the heck was going on, and big thanks to the users who reported the issue.[/p][p]I've patched this now with an updated save mechanic that will also allow for saves to persist between versions. While saves [i]will [/i]be reset when the game goes into full launch, this will at least mean not having to unlock everything multiple times from now on. There are also a couple of minor fixes for missions triggering, but beyond that, this is just a patch to fix the saves.[/p][p]Apologies to anyone who has played the recent builds, please go check out the new build as it should hopefully make it a whole lot less confusing... I hope.[/p][p]Happy flipping![/p][p]Kenny[/p]

notes.title: A new Demo and an enormous overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]PiN Update: Visuals & Physics Overhaul[/h1]

It's been a while since I last posted or updated, but hopefully the new screenshots should make it fairly obvious. I've spent the last couple of months giving the game a massive visual overhaul! Alongside the new look, there have been a ton of significant gameplay changes, which meant a stack of work just to get the demo playable again, one of the biggesting being that I've rebuilt the physics from the ground up, resulting in what I hope to be a much more realistic pinball simulation and making the game a good bit more challenging. And, good news, the demo is available once again!

With the new physics, I've also rebalanced bumper and blocker hit points, revisited and reworked the table traits (now called Curses), and added a new feature: chaining certain missions together now triggers one of four special effects.

[h2]Changelist (Not everything, but the highlights)[/h2]
[list]
[*]A whole new visual style: Creepy, dark, hand-drawn cartoon cult-vibes.
[*]Physics rebuilt: Hopefully this is a more accurate pinball experience.
[*]New Feature: Specials, including:
[*]Tempest: Rain down destruction from above for 10 seconds.
[*]Inferno: All active balls burst into flames, dealing area damage for 20 seconds.
[*]Sparks: Balls get electrified, dealing 10x critical damage for 30 seconds.
[*]Multiball:  Classic, fun multiball.
[*]A whole new tutorial/FTUE to match the new style and specials.
[*]Balance pass: All Glyphs (formerly SODA cans), Bumpers, Blockers, and Ball types have been reworked.
[*]Considerable performance improvements.
[*]Better Controller and Steam Deck compatibility.
[/list]
[h2]Heads Up & What's Next[/h2]
This is the first build after a lot of changes, so there are still a fair few bugs kicking about. Hopefully nothing major though, and I'll be trying to update the demo much more frequently now that this big milestone is out of the way so I'll get to squashing those at a much faster rate now.

No new trailer yet.  I'm still working on the table art for the other three tables, and I don't fancy spending a load of time on a trailer that only shows one, then having to redo it again a couple of weeks later. I'll get a new one up ASAP though.

[h2]Apologies & Release Window[/h2]
Anyway, apologies for the long gap between builds, but hopefully, that shouldn't be the case going forward. As for the full game release, I'm aiming for August/September, but keep an eye on this space (*cough* wishlist & follow) for more details.

Happy Flipping! 

Kenny

notes.title: Pin Demo v0.7.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Another small patch this week with some QoL upgrades, balance changes and bug fixes!

[u]v0.7.1 [/u]

[u]Features and Balance changes[/u]

- Duplicate Table Traits no longer appear in the same run
- Added a cycling 'To-Do' list on main menu to show all remaining achievements 
- Pryo and Watermelon Balls changed to boost damage and $ when hitting an active Bumper
- Blocker HP now scales off of your current Damage
- The Shop will always offer a Base Blocker perk if you don't currently have one active
- The Shop will always offer an Invert Flippers perk if the relevant Table Trait is active
- Rebalanced Bumper HP at varying stages
- Chances of all blocking effects from Table Traits reduced to 1 in 3 (was 1 in 2)
- $ Rewards for completing a stage reduced 
- Redesigned Bonus Tables to offer better rewards

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]

- Fixed a bug where the Bonus Block trait had a 100% chance of blocking Bonus item effects
- Fixed a number of perks that either displayed incorrectly or whose functionality wasn't working as intended
- Fixed issues with Damage per Score perks not being correctly calculated
- Fixed a  number of issues with the Achivement Unlocked panel when returning from a run
- Fixed a number of scenarios where the Slow-Mo effect wasn't triggering when it was meant to

Happy flipping!

Kenny

notes.title: PiN Demo Update - v0.6.22
notes.content:
​Another week, another patch! As always, massive thank you to those who have been reporting bugs, providing feedback etc. Please, please keep it coming!  

[b][u]v0.6.23[/u][/b]

- Major Change: Table Traits are now permanent, with an additional Trait applied every 4 Stages (every 2 on Expert+ Difficulties)
- Better visual clarity around Bonus Table and Rampage activation triggers
- Show remaining Achivements on Main Menu screen
- Shop will always show a Reset Base Bumper Perk if when you don't have one (dissapears on refresh)
- Shop will always show an Invert Flippers Perk when the Invert Flipper Table Trait is active 
- Balance pass on multiple Table Traits and Perks
- Reduced $ earned per stage to 8
- Reduced costs of Rare and Legendary Perks, as well as all Perk Traits.
- Text fixes throughout
​
Happy flipping!

Kenny

notes.title: Pin Demo v0.6.12 Patch Notes
notes.content:
First of all, a huge thank you to everyone who has played PiN so far, the feedback continues to be absolutely invaluable and a huge encouragement so please, keep it coming!

I've tried to address as much as I can in this patch, alongside a number of balance and visual changes that I've made recently while working on the core game, here's the summary:

v0.6.12

- All Difficulties now unlockable in Demo
- Fixed a bug after showing an achievement on the main menu where the game would become uninteractible
- Fixed a bug where the camera would stick on the bonus table when multiball was active on the main table
- Visual Clarity added around Table Traits and any currently active effect
- Bonus Table layout now changes each time it is activated
- Watermelon and Pyro ball effects changed to add 1$ and 1 Damage (respectively) each time an active bumper is hit
- Various Perks rebalanced

Happy flipping!

Kenny

notes.title: Demo v0.6.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
First of all, thank you all for your feedback and bug reports so far, without these I really am creating in a vacuum so please, keep them coming!

That said, I'm happy to announce v0.6.2 is now live with the following changes:

[i]- Blockers now have higher HP on all stages
- Nudge Save feature added when on Easy difficulty: a Slow Motion effect that triggers when the ball can be saved from the drain with a well-timed nudge. 
- 3 new Bonus Tables, picked at random at the start of a run. 
- Balance changes to Bumper HP on later stages
- Better physics detection, meaning fewer balls flying off the table
- Text fixes to provide clarity around some features
- Basic localization for all supprted languages
- Fix for a bug leading to players getting stuck on the bonus table[/i]

Thanks again for playing and happy flipping!!

Kenny
